content.summary: Hotel front office supervisor with 8 years of experience coordinating reception teams, reservations, concierge service, and guest recovery in high-occupancy beach properties.

experience.title: Front Office Supervisor
bullets: Supervised 10 reception colleagues during 78% average annual occupancy, sustaining a 96% check-in accuracy rate.
Implemented daily arrival briefings that reduced missed airport transfers by 42%.
Resolved guest-service escalations within 25 minutes on average, supporting a 4.7/5 review trend.

experience.title: Reservations Agent
bullets: Processed 2,800 annual room reservations across three partner properties.
Maintained booking records and payment confirmations with 99% monthly reconciliation accuracy.
